claim_text: The Bank of England's daily spot exchange rate data — the category series XUDLGBD (used as this company's FX conversion for the S&P 500 benchmark) belongs to — is prepared from Bloomberg BFIX and/or LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) as sources, and carries an explicit LSEG copyright restriction on republication. This confirms XUDLGBD's series family is one of the exchange rate series the Bank's legal page (SP500-0047, withdrawn) says are excluded from the Open Government Licence because they are reproduced under licence from a third party: the raw series may be used for internal calculation, but the underlying LSEG/Bloomberg-sourced values may not be republished or redistributed externally without LSEG's prior written consent.
source_1_name: Bank of England, "Further details about spot exchange rates data"
source_1_quote: The daily spot exchange rates are prepared using multiple sources. Bloomberg BFIX may at times be used as one of these. ... LSEG may also at times be used as source. Copyright / disclaimer: ©2025 LSEG. Republication or redistribution of LSEG content, including by framing or similar means, is prohibited without the prior written consent of LSEG.
